tools.name: get_property_info
tools.description: Facts about Hammergut Neidberg in Saxon Switzerland, Germany: location, check-in/out, what is included, tourist tax, pets, payment, cancellation and how booking works. Call this first when planning a stay.

tools.name: list_accommodations
tools.description: The 5 bookable units (4 apartments in the historic Hammergut + holiday house Waldhaus) with capacity, bedrooms, beds, pets, amenities (German) and photo URLs.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Live availability and exact prices (EUR, incl. VAT) for a stay. Returns per unit: available, total price, tourist tax, grand total, minimum stay, next free period if booked, and a pre-filled booking link. Without dates it returns the next free period per unit.

tools.name: create_booking_request
tools.description: Creates a booking request on behalf of the guest for one or more units (ids from list_accommodations / check_availability). Nothing is charged. The guest immediately receives an e-mail and must click the confirmation link within 15 minutes – only then is the booking binding; otherwise it expires. ON
